summary: Ascent rewards mid control, patient defaults, and layered utility for retakes.
tips: Contest mid with early recon or pressure so defenders cannot stack sites for free.
Save at least one smoke or flash for the lane between market and tree during executes.
Sentinel utility is strongest when it protects flank while duelists pressure catwalk or A main.

summary: Bind favors explosive site hits, teleport mix-ups, and strong post-plant utility.
tips: Use teleporters to punish rotates rather than as a default escape every round.
Controllers with layered smokes and molly lineups create stable post-plants on both sites.
Entry utility is especially valuable because chokes are narrow and easy to stall.

summary: Haven's three-site layout rewards information gathering and fast rotation calls.
tips: Use recon to confirm weak sites before committing because defenders are stretched thin.
Keep one anchor comfortable on the opposite side of the map to punish over-rotations.
Flexible duelists shine when they can pressure C long and pivot through garage.

summary: Sunset rewards teams that can clear angles methodically and convert mid control into split pressure.
tips: Mid presence opens both sites, so use initiator utility before committing bodies.
Trap-heavy sentinel setups are powerful because lurk timings are common on rotations.
Post-plant success improves when utility is saved for alley and market re-clears.
